As the sun and moon pass over the golden woods, winds from the distant plains leave their mark on the ancient stone walls. Beneath the stillness, something remains sealed within the ruins.
At the highest point of the layered peaks, an ancient massive cube still stands atop the mountain. Legend says this was once a sacred place, though those who once came here are long gone.
As time passes, grand halls crumble into ruin. Among the broken walls by the cliff, traces of the past can still be seen.
Storms once wore down the rocks, lightning carved the cliffs, and time gently healed them, as grass and trees softened the land’s scars.
Soil and stone have buried the ancient temple, while grass and trees have covered the traces of human activity, leaving only half of a strange, jagged boulder exposed.
Under the gaze of countless travelers, the ruins by the roadside have stood quietly for a thousand years, untouched by wind, rain, or lightning.
As the tide strikes the shore, traces of ancient ruins can be glimpsed between the white surf and pink reefs.
An ancient secret lies buried beneath the Mistwoods, and every flower and tree seems to guard the heart of the forest.
Ancient ruins divide the yellow and green earth, where the cool tones of the mountains meet the warmth of the plains.
Ancient canopies weave a dark green dome, scattering daylight into moss-cracked hollows, where silent eyes watch passing travelers.
Pebbles borne by the wind have scoured the stone for ages, leaving only a patch of primal bareness. In time, they too will crack and fade, until even these marks vanish without a trace.

entity.name: Iris
entity.description: Iris possesses an extremely lightweight body, often lifted by the wind. It then either slowly spirals downward using the resistance from its petal skirt, or simply allows itself to be carried away by the wind.

entity.name: Hummin
entity.description: They live on the grassland in groups, they like burrowing for nutrients, and they love singing off-key together!

entity.name: Flutternym
entity.description: They are timid and hide whenever they sense danger, but the fluorescent scales they shake off always give them away.

entity.name: Emberpup
entity.description: The lively creatures like to follow Flameruffs around. Once the smoldering fur starts to burn, they thrive.

entity.name: Chirpi
entity.description: They often hover at low altitudes, paying attention to every movement on the beach so they won't miss any opportunity.

entity.name: Pomegg
entity.description: They retreat into their shells to rest, often getting mistaken for eggs. They fear battle but love a crowd, dancing with grass balls to cheer others on.

entity.name: Nimbi
entity.description: Don't be surprised to see them floating in the clouds in small groups above the grasslands.

entity.name: Sparki
entity.description: Though they look like fire, those flames are only flowing energy. They give off no heat at all. In fact, they absorb heat from their surroundings. Sometimes they use this to disguise themselves as campfires and play tricks on others.

entity.name: Budclaw
entity.description: Mating for life, they're always found in pairs. The heartbloom atop their shells indicates their state of happiness.

entity.name: Celestis
entity.description: They love food! When they search the forest for food, the glowing stars on their heads are often mistaken for comets. They like hoarding food, adorning their nest with it.

entity.name: Jawling
entity.description: Loves to bite everything it sees. Its flexible jaw can open extremely wide. It shows affection through gentle nibbles.

entity.name: Bolty
entity.description: They live among the trees. When they attack, golden sparks flash from their tails with crackling electric sounds. Agile and quick on their feet, they are very difficult to catch.

entity.name: Wisptis
entity.description: If the only way to evolve is to defeat other Wisptises, then there is no other choice but to keep their claws sharp.

entity.name: Helmut
entity.description: That tough helmet keeps its squishy body safe, while those extendable mouth-claws help it hunt.

entity.name: Cubbo
entity.description: They spend the day sleepwalking. If woken up, they instantly become violent and lose control. Once they exhaust their energy, they fall back asleep like a baby.

entity.name: Bonesky
entity.description: An energetic pup with a pair of big ears. The ice-bone bow tie on its chest is its favorite toy. It hates Emberpups that don’t respect personal space.

entity.name: Skippy
entity.description: They like to hide underwater and observe their surroundings using a lotus leaf as a strikingly ineffective disguise.

entity.name: Dewy
entity.description: As partners to perfumers, they store and ferment nectar within their bodies, transforming it into perfume ingredients.

entity.name: Budsquire
entity.description: The timid crybabies can also rise up against enemies when cornered. The buds on their heads will blossom as they do so.

entity.name: Fentuft
entity.description: They always wear a signature smile and invite other aniimo to play. Though they sometimes cause trouble due to mischief and greed, they are always forgiven.

entity.name: Baleetle
entity.description: They never go anywhere without their stone balls, and the constant rolling makes the balls rounder and stranger.

entity.name: Susuta
entity.description: They dig around to search for gifts to give to their crushes, but their wooing always fails because they are so shy.

entity.name: Cozite
entity.description: Cozites build their shells bit by bit with mud. When in danger, they spray smoke from the top hole to cover the surroundings and hide themselves.

entity.name: Pebbling
entity.description: They are natural geologists who like eating all kinds of minerals. And what they eat determines how they grow.

entity.name: Flameruff
entity.description: Pack creatures that prize loyalty and unity, these hunters maintain focused, calm eyes that mask their fiery hearts.

entity.name: Shelly
entity.description: Conceals itself among beach shells using its soft appendages to hold shells in place. Remains sealed during daylight.

entity.name: Witchin
entity.description: They make bizarre noises to drive intruders to madness, lower their defenses and even cause them to pass out.

entity.name: Helmwhelp
entity.description: A fledgling concealing weakness under its helmet, dreaming of becoming strong enough to soar freely.

entity.name: Eko
entity.description: With their big ears perked up, they are extremely sensitive to sound. They won't miss any movement that catches their attention, near or far.

entity.name: Bulbly
entity.description: Their first reaction to everything is to escape, and their bulb-like organs indicate whether they are healthy.

entity.name: Pranky
entity.description: They like to stay cool and moist. That's what the layer of film over their bodies is for.

entity.name: Fenrier
entity.description: Resisting gentle pets that might soften its resolve, it leads pack hunts with its ice blade.

entity.name: Lavazar
entity.description: They use hard claws to crush crystals and eat them to store heat, causing fiery red patterns to appear on their body. Though small, they can continuously spew high-heat flame streams from their mouth.

entity.name: Flamerion
entity.description: They only come out at night and their bodies are made of gaseous energy and can split as they want!

entity.name: Cornet
entity.description: They can produce loud, piercing noises that resonate throughout the entire beach just to draw attention.

entity.name: Fahloo
entity.description: They rub the oil on their bodies to create a thick foam. This foam cleans and protects them, though they sometimes slip on it by accident.

entity.name: Shrubclaw
entity.description: The lush plants that cover their shells convert sunlight into nutrients, so they don't even need to eat on sunny days.

entity.name: Irisal
entity.description: Devoted to the art of dance, they constantly hone their craft, hoping to share the pure joy and energy of movement.

entity.name: Gracewing
entity.description: Lone wanderers. They create illusions by shedding scales from their wings when threats approach.

entity.name: Popota
entity.description: They select shells and make them into shovels. It's said that they produce pink bubbles when they see someone they love.

entity.name: Tromber
entity.description: They like having fun and producing rhythmic music, so don't be surprised to see a grand symphony.

entity.name: Helgon
entity.description: Covered in hard armor, they look like tall statues when they stand still, as if standing guard over ancient treasures.

entity.name: Glacy
entity.description: They are elegant and kind aniimo that always take care of weaker ones, and freeze anyone who crosses them in ice.

entity.name: Tubster
entity.description: Creates deep, tuba-like sounds that match its steady, friendly character.

entity.name: Veilfloat
entity.description: A light-dependent creature that glows when night falls, keeping its light on even while sleeping.

entity.name: Erlath
entity.description: Their feathers constantly secrete oil, creating various bubbles with just a little friction. They naturally use the softest, densest foam to protect the Fahloos on their backs.

entity.name: Ignitis
entity.description: They sharpen their blades and wait for the perfect moment, hiding in the shadows as they toy with their prey. As cold-blooded assassins, they seek to end every fight in a single strike.

entity.name: Scorchhowl
entity.description: They enjoy the thrill of the fight since flame and burning mark their growth.

entity.name: Thornblade
entity.description: The swords made from thorny stems are drawn only when it's time to protect their pack against enemies.

entity.name: Fragrancier
entity.description: They're picky about odors, so they harvest and store various nectar within them to craft unique perfume ingredients.

entity.name: Pomawk
entity.description: Their towering manes display their wild nature, while their feral roars reveal their true colors. Their tails are built to store sound waves, releasing a sonic boom when they strike an opponent.

entity.name: Rookey
entity.description: Despite its imposing size, it is timid and avoids conflict. It finds its courage when friends need protection.

entity.name: Bouldus
entity.description: A round stone that had stayed with Baleetle day and night woke up from all that bumping. Tired of being controlled, it swallowed an insect and could finally move by its own will.

entity.name: Bailite
entity.description: Bailites' anatomy allows independent rotation of their upper and lower bodies. This means they can observe surroundings flexibly, ready to transform into turrets to repel opponents.

entity.name: Grizbo
entity.description: They hide constant endurance and restraint beneath a gentle exterior. However, if provoked or hungry, they lose control and fall into a frenzy.

entity.name: Luminelle
entity.description: Changes its glow to match its mood while its tentacles create mesmerizing patterns and deliver shocking attacks.

entity.name: Melloblum
entity.description: To quell disputes, they scatter fragrant petals, causing those who touch them to feel happiness and crush their fighting spirit.

entity.name: Sheldon
entity.description: Lying on their shells, they face the night sky, drowning in a dream woven by the stars.

entity.name: Stellarys
entity.description: They prefer solitude and often move through the night. With their starry, cloak-like forms, they resemble mysterious mages and can teleport using psychic energy.

entity.name: Waleetle
entity.description: They move backwards like their kin, but in a much fancier way.

entity.name: Blazen
entity.description: They use their special fur to capture charged particles in the air to produce and store electricity.

entity.name: Glynsera
entity.description: Proud and confident warriors, the chilling blades in its mouth send shivers down its enemies' spines.

entity.name: Sherro
entity.description: They turn the shells that once covered them into swords and shields to protect fragile Shellies along the coastline.

entity.name: Turbo
entity.description: They like to sleep hidden in the clouds, because with the presence of wind pressure and static electricity, the fluffy wool easily attracts things that drift by on the wind.

entity.name: Fenmane
entity.description: Using the excellent conductivity of their fur, they condense the power of lightning to extend their wings, dashing to dispel the haze and brighten their mood.

entity.name: Leafy
entity.description: They live among lotus flowers and use their lotus leaf tails to conceal their face and show off their elegant nature.

entity.name: Magmarex
entity.description: Scorching crystals grow on their body like solidified lava. If the stored heat erupts, it can melt everything in their path.

entity.name: Eklue
entity.description: Curious and keen on searching for traces and tracking targets. The ring on their tail amplifies ultrasound, allowing them to easily see through cloaked creatures.

entity.name: Panpanta
entity.description: They are strong and powerful, but they'd rather stay in their nests and decorate than show off their muscles.

entity.name: Pawney
entity.description: Armed with a broken sword and armor, blessed with courage and might, it defends its friends and challenges its foes.

entity.name: Lumin Amber
entity.description: These highly pure energy ambers originated from the overflowing Vein energy and have been refined over the ages. The power they contain is so intense that it can illuminate the surroundings, which earned it the name Lumin.

entity.name: Aniipod
entity.description: A device for catching, equipping, and training aniimo. Polaris Institute researchers developed it using Lumintech after drawing inspiration from Ancient Idyll Civilization ruins.

entity.name: Aniipod Pro
entity.description: The first upgraded product in the Aniipod series, designed to help Pathfinders catch Aniimo with greater ease.

entity.name: Sunny Daisy
entity.description: A yellow flower with petals that sparkle when bathed in sunlight. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Red Cap
entity.description: An obscure crimson mushroom with a cap as bright as a blazing flame. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Lunar Daisy
entity.description: White petals that shimmer like scattered starlight. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Orange Cap
entity.description: Orange fungi that seem to have captured the sun’s essence, with caps as smooth and polished as amber. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Starine
entity.description: Fruit of a Starine Tree. Celestis family’s favorite food.

entity.name: Azur Grass
entity.description: Blue flowers cluster tightly together, forming a plump, rounded bloom. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Blue Cap
entity.description: Radiating mysterious deep blue light, with caps that shimmer with a Water-like luster. Can be sold in the inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Ferric Charstone
entity.description: High-quality iron with a metallic sheen. Helmut and Jawling can absorb the iron element within to strengthen themselves.

entity.name: Charstone
entity.description: Charred rock formed by the flames of certain Aniimo. Charstone fragments can also be obtained while mining Ferric Charstone.

entity.name: Glintstone
entity.description: Large mineral ore found in Pebbling Cave. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Mutant Truffle
entity.description: A rare special mushroom from Mistwoods containing unique energy

entity.name: Flufftail Grass
entity.description: A resilient wildgrass resembling aniimo's fuzzy tail.

entity.name: Pearl-Strung Blossom
entity.description: Clusters of delicate blooms adorn its broad, graceful leaves, creating an elegant display.

entity.name: Spiked Herb
entity.description: A humble herb with delicate spikes of blossoms carries a distinctive aroma.

entity.name: Turtleback Ore
entity.description: A vibrant-colored mineral veined with tortoiseshell patterns.

entity.name: Dreamtide Bloom
entity.description: A celestial seaflower that glows beneath the waves. Its crystalline petals dance with ocean currents, radiating otherworldly grace.

entity.name: Morning Star Bloom
entity.description: A delicate flower with star-shaped petals that unfurl at dawn, releasing a subtle, sweet fragrance.

entity.name: Tartball
entity.description: A round, tangy wild berry and a favorite of aniimo.

entity.name: Threadstar Plant
entity.description: A plant with broad, glossy leaves veined with intricate web-like patterns.

entity.name: Large Starine
entity.description: A certain Stellarys living in the Forest of Falling Stars loves collecting these huge and rare Starines.

entity.name: Mint
entity.description: When refined, it can be used to create "Slumberscent." This premium ingredient emits an invigorating fragrance.

entity.name: Sweetfern Nut
entity.description: A hardy nut with pinnate leaves and a rock-hard shell. Its dense, honeyed flesh makes great desserts.

entity.name: Chroma Ore
entity.description: A vibrantly colored mineral that gleams with a unique luster in sunlight.

entity.name: Chromaflare Peony
entity.description: Chromaflare peonies have massive clusters of petals in riotous colors, each bloom shimmering with an inner radiance.

entity.name: Stardust Agate
entity.description: A naturally formed gemstone born where ocean meets land, its speckled patterns etched by the rhythm of the tides.

entity.name: Truffle
entity.description: Delicious mushroom found in Mistwoods. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Homeland Co-op Store for Home Coins.

entity.name: Star Grass
entity.description: The rhizome is used in "Slumberscent" production, offering excellent quality with a delicate, enchanting fragrance.

entity.name: Treasured Large Starine
entity.description: A special large Starine from a large Starine tree. Love and longing, rich and enduring. Perfumer Dael, who lingers in the Forest of Falling Stars, may transform it into something remarkable.

entity.name: Whitesnow Rose Nectar
entity.description: Whitesnow Rose Nectar. After a Dewy put it into its nest, it can be used to brew Whitesnow Rose Aromathysts.

entity.name: Elite Egg
entity.description: An Egg with powerful vitality. Guaranteed to hatch an Aniimo with Elite potential or higher.

entity.name: Highland Egg
entity.description: A mysterious life stirs within this shell, ready to emerge.

entity.name: Alpha Egg
entity.description: An Egg with unusual size and powerful energy fluctuations. Guaranteed to hatch an Aniimo with the Alpha trait.

entity.name: Forest Egg
entity.description: A mysterious life stirs within this shell, ready to emerge.

entity.name: Grassland Egg
entity.description: A mysterious life stirs within this shell, ready to emerge.

entity.name: Blossom Egg
entity.description: A mysterious life stirs within this shell, ready to emerge.

entity.name: Egg of Prayers
entity.description: An egg left behind by an unknown Aniimo, brimming with vibrant life.

entity.name: Elite Emberpup Egg
entity.description: An Emberpup Egg. A unique scent seems to linger on its shell. Brimming with life, it is guaranteed to hatch into an Emberpup with Elite potential or higher.

entity.name: Incredible Grassland Egg

regions.name: Nimbus Fields
regions.desc: Soft clouds drift low over the velvety sea of grass as Nimbis bounce lightly across the open wilds, and the scent of fresh grass ripples through the green waves.

regions.name: The Argent Strait
regions.desc: Silver sand and blue sea reflect one another as flocks of Chirpis blare trumpet-like calls among the coastal cliffs, adding a lively melody to the bay on the sea breeze.

regions.name: Forest of Falling Stars
regions.desc: Following the stream upstream into a dense purple forest, Celestises fly among the Starine Trees like tiny shooting stars.

regions.name: Sea of Flowers
regions.desc: An endless sea of flowers paints the land in romantic colors, and the air is rich with their fragrance. A small village known for making perfumes sits nestled among purple flower fields, living alongside Aniimo for generations.

regions.name: Beast Fang Ridge
regions.desc: Giant rocks like wolf fangs tower over the mountaintop, where Emberpups and Boneskies make their home. The two groups often clash in fiery and icy disputes over territory.

regions.name: Mistwoods
regions.desc: Off-key singing echoes through the rotting deadwood, while the swamp deep in the mist bubbles with poison miasma. Thankfully, gleaming glimmer fruit shines like glass lanterns to guide lost travelers.

regions.name: Blitzwood
regions.desc: Drawn by Bolties, thunder carves furrows into the earth, digging gray scorched soil out of a grassy slope while flickering electric sparks crackle in the thunder-struck wood.

regions.name: Echoback Landing
regions.desc: Why hasn’t the enormous Aniimo stranded on the shoal returned to the embrace of the deep sea? The answer may lie within the haunting whale song.

regions.name: Berylline Causeway
regions.desc: Stacks of sea-eroded rock rise layer by layer, with wind-carved stone pillars standing among them. Emerald grass spreads across the natural stone terraces step by step.

regions.name: Driftwise Meadow
regions.desc: Beneath the snowy peaks, Glacy drift through icy lakes. Downstream, lively sparks dart among soft fluffs, scattering the haze over the meadow.

regions.name: Rosetower Woods
regions.desc: Pines stand tall on both sides of the mountain road, and bear shadows sometimes flicker among the trees. At the end of the path stands a white tower wreathed in thorns, sealed in dust. Will the day come when the Rose blooms?

regions.name: Russet Highlands
regions.desc: Orange and yellow plants stain the gray rock and soil a deep cinnabar hue as mysterious winged shadows sweep past the steep mountain slopes, stirring up a blazing storm among the altar ruins.

regions.name: Tideblossom Coast
regions.desc: The dreamy flowers bloom splendidly as if they are blossoming for the last time. The tides carry away all the fallen petals like flowing satin until they disappear at the edge of the shallow waters.

regions.name: Zephyrus Landbridge
regions.desc: A massive ant fortress of piled sandstone stands at the edge of the cape, with industrious Cozites bustling through its halls, while deep in the valley, scorching heat billows from the cavern below as Lavazars clash with subterranean crystals, scattering sparks like stars.
